D3.title: Private drafts: route B or C? (route A is ruled out)
D3.lead: PQRT's two private draft files cannot reach the folder by the Drive tool, and you cannot get them to save by hand (Route A is ruled out). The Oracle's packet (#128 6320447599) says: the files may still exist in PQRT's own session, so first check that privately. Moving them needs a real file-reference bridge and a Drive identity that is allowed to write to the folder. Neither exists yet.

options.label: B (suggested)
options.body: Step 1 now: PQRT privately rechecks that both existing ZIPs (and the Physics source it holds) still exist, with name, size and SHA-256 against the receipt above. No upload yet. Step 2 only when a real file-reference bridge and a writer identity for the folder are shown to work: one upload retry of the unchanged files, then a byte check of each saved file. If the files are gone, regeneration is allowed only if PQRT still holds the authorized source; otherwise it stops and you restore the source.
options.reply: Drive: Route B, step 1 only. PQRT privately rechecks that both existing ZIPs and its Physics source still exist (name, size, SHA-256), no upload. An upload retry only after a real file-reference bridge and a folder writer identity are shown to work.
options.short: Drive: Route B, step 1 only: PQRT rechecks privately that both ZIPs and its source still exist, no upload until a real bridge and writer identity work.

options.label: C
options.body: Hold. No more upload attempts, no new authoring and no sharing changes. You provide a secure way to move binary files, then we restart.
options.reply: Drive: Route C. Hold. No more upload attempts or new authoring until I provide a secure way to move binary files.
